purpose: NS21 — Finset/aesop imitation training: evaluation manifest.

core_preservation.description: Must not regress vs gen_v5_ns12_balanced / NS15 routed baselines.

finset_transfer_in_distribution.description: Held-out Finset surfaces — gains here measure transfer beyond the 6 pool theorems.
finset_transfer_in_distribution.note: ns17_finset_extra contains 3 of the 6 pool theorems; cx1_finset_image_filter contains 2. Both still serve as held-out for the remaining theorems on each surface.

negative_control_set.description: Set theorems must NOT be routed to the Finset model. NS18 aesop wrapper-only previously regressed Set.inter_singleton_eq_empty by 10/30; we verify the router prevents this leakage by keeping ^Set\. on NS12.
